sheet.description: One typed sheet, one typewriter and one carbon, with four transmissions separated by rules.

receipt_stamps.body: MINISTERIO DE LA GUERRA / ESTADO MAYOR DEL [...] / ENTRADA
receipt_stamps.hand: date, number and annotation written by hand on the stamp

receipt_stamps.body: Estado Mayor del Ministerio de la Guerra / SECCION DE INFORMACION / ENTRADA
receipt_stamps.note: the date box is too faint to read on the image

date_note: The transmission line gives only the day and the hour. The month and year come from the ENTRADA stamp of the sheet, 8 December 1936.
recipient: Comandante Jefe E.M. de Baleares (Palma de Mallorca)
preamble_clear: Me refiero a error en YPSQ VHRH DHZB NWTC
body: WREO DAVV WOQR PODI UJCJ SOZU MICW YTYE ORWZ FBOR JQDO YXNM EHRM HDTY VSST YZSL ATRG UUST MZDG GSJL BZHD
notes: A preamble in clear designates an earlier transmission by its four header groups, and the message reuses that header. The plaintext is the correction the preamble announces: a last seven for a fourteen, a last eight for a fifteen. W is the manual's separator. GRUPOKNABE is not resolved; QUIBCE for QUINCE is the one doubtful letter.

solution.reading: CORRIJA PRIMERA SERIE GRUPO KNABE [WWW] ULTIMO SIETE [W] POR [W] UN CATORCE Y ULTIMO OCHO POR UN QUI[N]CE
solution.command_note: No crib: the key is the first entry of the list of candidates that carry a run of W.

negative_results.swept: Blind search on wirings D and F: six rotor orders, the 24 assignments of the header letters, all 26^4 Ringstellungen.
negative_results.scored_by: Index of coincidence of the decrypt, with 0.069 as the line between a reading and noise; a list of fragments of naval Spanish as second criterion.
negative_results.explanation: The key was inside the space and was enumerated. Its decrypt has an index of coincidence of 0.0595, while noise in a search of this size reached 0.0731, and its vocabulary shares nothing with the fragment list. The same search ranked by python/lang_model.py (windowed trigram and the W rule) recovers it with no crib.
